claim: *Spotify projected onto MAGE.* Persistent estate representation feeds targeting, concurrent execution, and fleet-level supervision; the reading is judgment moving upstream, not the PR count.
topology: See source-specific field-guide graph and receipt redesign.
required_terms: human judgment what · where · when · whether
Agents implement concurrently; scarce human judgment moves upstream.
bw_encoding: Ordinary nodes, artifacts, evidence and outcomes are white. Named roles, position and relation styles provide the necessary distinctions.
redesign: Field-guide visual argument preserved; decorative header/footer dropped. Evidence caveats retained explicitly rather than color/half-disc glyph alone.
alt: Spotify projected onto MAGE: five agents implement concurrently below a human-judgment box labeled what, where, when, and whether. An upward arrow emphasizes judgment moving upstream; the judgment box connects to the Governed Engineering Environment.

style_review.fill: Ordinary nodes, artifacts, evidence and outcomes are white. Named roles, position and relation styles provide the necessary distinctions.
style_review.bold: Regular node labels and annotations retained; no arbitrary bold introduced.
style_review.routing: Entry uses a vertical port aligned to the first execution station; upstream judgment arrow and environment relation retained.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Rendered and visually inspected all 43 pages, including enlarged inspection of revised gate branches and crowded peer junctions. Required dashed relationships, icons, topology, labels and external annotations retained. Geometry checks supplement, rather than replace, visual review.
